title: The structure sheaf of rings on the small pro-etale site
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $S_{\mathrm{proet}}$ its small pro-etale site
[def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site]. The *structure sheaf* $\mathcal O_S$ on
$S_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is the presheaf of commutative rings

$$
 \mathcal O_S(U)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)\qquad(U\to S\text{ weakly etale}),
$$

whose restriction map along a morphism $h:V\to U$ over $S$ is the ring map
$h^\sharp:\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ on global sections. Here $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)=\mathcal O_U(U)$ is the ring of sections over the whole scheme $U$, and $h^\sharp$ is the component over $U$ of the morphism of structure sheaves of $h$. It is a
sheaf of rings on $S_{\mathrm{proet}}$: as a presheaf of sets it is isomorphic to
$U\mapsto\operatorname{Mor}(U,\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[t])$ (a morphism to
$\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[t]$ is a ring map $\mathbf Z[t]\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$,
i.e. a global section), where $\operatorname{Spec}$ is the spectrum construction [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; hence it is representable on schemes and satisfies the sheaf
condition for fpqc coverings; the coverings of $S_{\mathrm{proet}}$ are fpqc coverings,
and the sheaf condition for a presheaf of rings is that of its underlying presheaf of
sets.

source.place: Definition 03P4 (1) (etale-cohomology-definition-additive-sheaf: the sheaf $T\mapsto\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$, denoted $\mathcal O_S$ or $\mathbf G_a$) and Definition 04HS (etale-cohomology-definition-structure-sheaf); the sheaf property by Lemma 03O3 (etale-cohomology-lemma-representable-sheaf-fpqc: representable presheaves are fpqc sheaves) or Theorem 03OJ (etale-cohomology-theorem-quasi-coherent)

proof.text: Restrict the global-sections functor Scheme.Γ along the opposite of the forgetful functor from the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site] to schemes [def-pc-scheme]. This is exactly proEtaleStructurePresheaf, so the values and restriction maps are unchanged.

For every commutative ring R, the affine-target adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme] identifies the presheaf U ↦ Hom(R, Γ(U, O_U)) naturally with Hom(U, Spec R). The source library packages this as ΓSpec.representableBy. The big pro-etale topology is subcanonical: it is coarser than the fpqc topology, whose representable descent is [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent]. Hence each of these Hom presheaves is a sheaf. By the definition of the sheaf condition for a category-valued presheaf, Scheme.Γ is therefore a ring-valued sheaf. This is precisely the proved source-library theorem Scheme.isSheaf_Γ applied to proetaleTopology.

The forgetful functor ProEt.forget S ⋙ Over.forget S is continuous from the small pro-etale topology [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site] to the big pro-etale topology, as proved in Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Proetale. Apply Functor.op_comp_isSheaf_of_isSheaf to the ring-valued sheaf of the previous step. Its conclusion is definitionally the sheaf condition of proEtaleStructurePresheaf S. Bundle that presheaf with this proof to obtain proEtaleStructureSheaf S.
